decisions.reason: After two years the accelerator program, which lies outside the core machinery business, has shown no clear partnership or deal-flow value, and the firm has already refocused its resources by dropping Product C, so this option is now more likely worthless than uncertain and should be closed.

The CO2-negative bio-bitumen remains a flagship whose large upside depends on slow-moving construction and regulatory adoption, so its uncertainty has not resolved and keeping the option open is still justified.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the decentralized recycling strategy and the firm's existing manufacturing know-how, so it is cheap to maintain and its prospects remain promising.
